portInfo.description: PTSC Phu My Port sits in the Cai Mep–Thi Vai deep-water cluster and markets itself as an early Vietnamese deep-water general-cargo port handling vessels to 80,000 DWT. Published infrastructure includes a main wharf 385 m long, 27 m wide, draft −14.5 m, plus a 320 m ship/barge wharf for craft to 4,500 DWT, on a 26.5 ha site. Contact: Street 3, Phu My 1 Industrial Park; +84 254 392 1658; info@ptscphumy.com.vn. Ocean cruise ships use these industrial berths rather than a purpose-built cruise village — expect security, coaches, and a long transfer to Ho Chi Minh City.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: You are not walking into downtown Saigon from the gangway.
